events.did: 冲进 Mugikura Riding Club 马厩（回头看见自己的红色摩托倒在入口中央）；摸进靠墙码放的干草垛找自己藏的皮包没找到，摸到一张撕破的一万日元纸币（torn 10,000-yen bill）
events.quote_head: I rushed into the stable at Mugikura
events.quote_anchor: pulling out clumps of straw with my fists as if weeding a garden, my hand closed around a torn 10,000-yen bill.

events.did: 嚼钱——她听见重鼻息与撕裂声，转向马嘴看见一摞纸币（a stack of bills）挂在嘴外；她趴地捡拾混进干草的一万日元纸币，所有纸币都被嚼得破烂
events.quote_head: At the same time, I heard a
events.quote_anchor: I turned my gaze toward Strada’s mouth to find a stack of bills hanging out of it.

events.did: 用嘴叼起原先被蹄踩着的黑色皮包，从敞开的厩门走出去；每走一步就掉下裹着唾液的纸币摞，包中间被嚼出一个大洞（她说“那笔钱是给你的”）
events.quote_head: Without answering my question, my horse used
events.quote_anchor: my horse used his mouth to grab the black leather bag that he had been stepping on with his hoof

events.did: 我捡起马一路掉落的纸币走出马厩，喊“Strada!”他不肯停；我抱满湿碎纸币喘着气跟上去，嘴角上扬微笑；顿悟：他全懂——我们不需要钱，只需要在一起
events.quote_head: As I left the stable, picking up
events.quote_anchor: As I shuffled after him, out of breath, my arms full of wet and shredded bills, the corners of my mouth began to rise.

events.did: 我从身后伸手去抓 Strada 的缰绳（“一起逃吧”）；瞬间像被汽车撞上一样被弹飞——Strada 眼珠上翻、用后腿踢了我，一捧一万日元纸币飞散空中；天旋地转，我仰面摔在泥地上
events.quote_head: Emboldened, I extended my hands toward Strada’s
events.quote_anchor: Strada, with his eyes rolled back in his head, had kicked me with his hind legs.

events.did: 小心摸自己的鼻子确认伤势：满手血黏、鼻梁断、扭向左侧
events.quote_head: Cautiously, I touched my nose. It was
events.quote_anchor: It was slimy with blood and certainly broken, twisted toward the left.

events.did: Strada 若无其事地看向我这边；我顾不上止鼻血回望他，他没有移开视线；我细看那双乌黑如弹珠的眼睛——里面没有我（眼中无她）
events.quote_head: Strada looked my way nonchalantly, as if
events.quote_anchor: I looked hard to see if I appeared in them, but I didn’t.

events.did: 警笛越来越近，红光轮流照亮他的眼与我的眼；站在那里的只是一匹马，别无其他（终句）
events.quote_head: The sirens grew closer, and the red
events.quote_anchor: The sirens grew closer, and the red lights lit up his eyes and mine in turn.
